title: High cyclomatic complexity: _iscsi_get_target (CCN=23)
detail: `_iscsi_get_target` has a cyclomatic complexity of 23 over 63 lines (L132–202). Functions this complex are hard to test exhaustively, tend to accumulate subtle conditional bugs, and resist refactoring. Suggested fix: extract cohesive sub-operations into smaller, named functions with clear preconditions.

title: Inconsistent return statements: 2 functions mix explicit/implicit returns (L105,L284)
detail: Some functions return a value on some paths and fall off the end (returning `None` implicitly) on others. Callers that rely on the return value may receive `None` unexpectedly. Suggested fix: add an explicit `return` on all branches or refactor to raise on error paths.
